title: Berge Conjecture
exact_target: Are all knots in the three-sphere with a nontrivial lens-space surgery among Berge’s knot families?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1480 (TOP-002). CC BY 4.0.
Joshua Evan Greene, The Lens Space Realization Problem, arXiv:1010.6257v1 (2010), Section 1, Conjecture 1.1, Theorem 1.3 and Section 1.2 on Berge’s enumerated knots.
Kenneth L. Baker, Dorothy Buck and Ana G. Lecuona, Some Knots in S1×S2 with Lens Space Surgeries, arXiv:1302.7011v1 (2013), Section 1, first two paragraphs on the S3 Berge conjecture.
